type_classes.normalisation: lowercase and trim; remove a CHARACTER SET/CHARSET clause; remove a COLLATE clause and keep its name (quotes removed); read the first (...) group as the parameters (comma-separated integers, or the single word max on a text base; anything else is an invalid parameter list) and remove every (...) group; collapse whitespace. The remainder is the base name.
type_classes.identity: every other base name (char_family, citext, uuid, boolean, temporal, real/float/double, enum, set, json, arrays, binary and custom names), any name with an invalid parameter list, any name with a COLLATE outside deterministic_collations, and an undeclared column (column_type null)
